note: Descriptions written for this editor from what the properties do, for the properties and values that 117's schema files and Anno 1800's descriptions leave empty. A key is a property (Building) or a value path below it (Building/Costs/Amount). Not game text.

descriptions.Standard: The asset's identity: its GUID, name and icon, and the texts the game shows for it.
descriptions.Standard/GUID: The number that identifies the asset; other assets name it by this number. Keep it unique across the game and all mods.
descriptions.Standard/IconFilename: The picture file the game and this editor show for the asset (a path in the game's files).
descriptions.Building: What a building is and how it is placed: its type, the terrain it may stand on, its variations and the effects it gives.
descriptions.Building/BuildingType: The kind of building (residence, factory, public building, ...); menus and rules sort buildings by it.
descriptions.Building/BuildingCategoryName: The text id of the name of the building's category, as the construction menu and its tooltips show it.
descriptions.Building/OriginHint: The asset the building comes from, for example the building it replaces or upgrades; used by menus and unlocks.
descriptions.Building/CanBeBuildOnAreasWithState: The area states (the ownership or build state of a construction area) in which the building may be placed.
descriptions.Building/ConstructionMenuIconOverride: A picture file shown in the construction menu instead of the asset's own icon.
descriptions.Building/HasBorderRectOutline: Whether a rectangular outline is drawn round the building's border while it is placed.
descriptions.Building/TerrainType2: The kinds of terrain the building may be built on (for example plain land, coast or water).
descriptions.Building/AllowWaterPlacement: An asset that, when it is active or unlocked, lets the building be placed on water.
descriptions.Building/AllowCoastPlacement: An asset that, when it is active or unlocked, lets the building be placed on the coast.
descriptions.Building/InfluencedByNeighbors: Buildings next to which this one changes its look; each item names such a neighbour building.
descriptions.Building/InfluencedByNeighbors/Building: A neighbouring building that changes this building's variation.
descriptions.Building/InfluencedVariationDirection: How a neighbour's side decides which variation of the building is drawn.
descriptions.Building/InfluencedVariationDirection/Di: The side, as a whole number, from which the neighbour is looked at.
descriptions.Building/InfluencedVariationDirection/Ty: The kind of building block the neighbour is, as far as the variation is concerned.
descriptions.Building/BuildingBlockPool: Per kind of building block, the pool of variations the building takes when it is placed beside one.
descriptions.Building/BuildingBlockPool/Pool: The variations to choose from, each with a direction offset and a variation number.
descriptions.Building/BuildingBlockPool/Pool/Directio: How many steps the direction is turned for this variation.
descriptions.Building/BuildingBlockPool/Pool/Variatio: The number of the variation that is used.
descriptions.Building/BuildModeStartVariation: The variation shown first when the player starts placing the building.
descriptions.Building/VariationIcons/IconFilename: The picture file that stands for one variation in the build menu.
descriptions.Building/AlternativeGrassColorAvailable: Whether the grass under the building may take an alternative colour.
descriptions.Building/FadeOutInGhostMode: Whether the building fades out while the player is in the mode that shows buildings as ghosts.
descriptions.Building/OwnerChangeDestroy: Whether the building is destroyed when its island changes owner.
descriptions.Building/BuildModePlacement: Which placement helpers are allowed while the building is placed.
descriptions.Building/BuildModePlacement/AllowXZ: Whether the building may be placed freely on the ground plane.
descriptions.Building/BuildModePlacement/AllowAQ00: Whether one of the grid-aligned placements (the first of the grid's quarter turns) is allowed.
descriptions.Building/BuildModePlacement/AllowAQ10: Whether the other grid-aligned placement is allowed.
descriptions.Building/FunctionalEffects: Effects that are active while the building works; each item names an effect asset.
descriptions.Building/FunctionalEffects/FunctionalEff: An effect asset that applies while the building is active.
descriptions.Building/VariationControl: Who chooses the building's variation: the player, the neighbours or chance.
descriptions.Building/OverrideDragBuild: Settings that change how the building is placed when the player drags a row or an area of them.
descriptions.Building/OverrideDragBuild/Enabled: Whether these drag settings are used.
descriptions.Building/OverrideDragBuild/DragRowMax: The most buildings placed in one dragged row.
descriptions.Building/OverrideDragBuild/DragPolygonGU: The polygon asset that gives the shape of a dragged area.
descriptions.Building/OverrideDragBuild/DragPolygonSi: The largest size a dragged area may have.
descriptions.Building/SteepnessMaxHeightDiff: The greatest height difference over the building's ground that still allows it to be placed.
descriptions.Building/ThirdPartyFakeClaimingBuilding: Whether the building counts as a claim of the ground for third parties (non-player owners).
descriptions.Building/CornerBuilding: The building that takes this one's place when it stands on a corner.
descriptions.Building/NonCornerBuilding: The building that takes this one's place when it no longer stands on a corner.
descriptions.Building/EmbankmentReplacement: The building that replaces this one where an embankment is placed.
descriptions.Cost: What it costs to construct something: the goods and the money, and factors that change them.
descriptions.Cost/Costs: The goods or items the construction takes, each with an amount.
descriptions.Cost/Costs/Ingredient: A product or an item that is paid.
descriptions.Cost/Costs/Amount: How many of the ingredient are paid.
descriptions.Cost/CostFactor: A factor on the costs that applies once something is unlocked.
descriptions.Cost/CostFactor/Unlock: The unlock asset that switches the factor on.
descriptions.Cost/CostFactor/CostFactor: The factor that is applied to the costs (a number, or a percentage).
descriptions.Maintenance: What a building costs to keep: money and workforce, in total or per length of road.
descriptions.Maintenance/Maintenances: The running costs, each as a product with an amount.
descriptions.Maintenance/Maintenances/Product: The product the building consumes to run (money, or a kind of workforce).
descriptions.Maintenance/Maintenances/Amount: How much of the product is used in a minute.
descriptions.Maintenance/Maintenances/PerUnitLengths: When set, the amount is counted per this many units of length instead of once (roads and walls).
descriptions.Maintenance/WorkforceAmountFactor: A factor on every workforce amount of the building.
descriptions.Maintenance/IncomeCategory: The category under which the building's income and costs appear in the economy statistics.
descriptions.Maintenance/WorkforceDeficitBuffs: Buffs that apply while the building lacks workforce, by how much of it is available.
descriptions.Maintenance/WorkforceDeficitBuffs/Availa: The share of the needed workforce (0 to 1) at or below which the buff applies.
descriptions.Maintenance/EncampedUnitScalingFactor: A factor on the upkeep while units are encamped at the building.
descriptions.Maintenance/ShowLowWorkforceInfolayer: Whether the info layer for missing workforce is shown for this building.
descriptions.Maintenance/StatisticScreenMoneyCategory: The category of the statistics screen under which the building's money is counted.
descriptions.Maintenance/ConsiderMaintenanceDifficult: Whether the difficulty setting changes the money costs.
Whether the difficulty setting changes the workforce costs.
descriptions.Maintenance/HasInactiveMaintenance: Whether the building still has upkeep while it is switched off.
descriptions.Health: How much damage an object takes, how it heals and what is left when it is destroyed.
descriptions.Health/UnitDefenderType: The kind of defender the object is, as combat rules count it.
descriptions.Health/CanBePlundered: Whether the object may be plundered.
descriptions.Health/BaseHealth: The hit points of the object.
descriptions.Health/PausedTimeIfAttacked: How long healing stays paused after the object was attacked.
descriptions.Health/AlertRange: The distance within which an attack on the object raises an alert.
descriptions.Health/HPBarOffset: How far above the object its health bar is drawn.
descriptions.Health/DefenseByAIFactor: A factor on the object's defence when a computer player owns it.
descriptions.Health/BlockBuildActionsAfterAttackDurat: How long building actions stay blocked after the object was attacked.
descriptions.Health/CreatePamsyUponDestruction: Whether a message is created when the object is destroyed.
descriptions.Health/HasRuinState: Whether the object is left as a ruin when it is destroyed.
descriptions.Health/RuinStateConfig: How the ruin looks and behaves.
descriptions.Health/RuinStateConfig/UsedRuinStateBeha: The kind of ruin behaviour that is used.
descriptions.Health/RuinStateConfig/CustomRuinStateCf: A model file for a ruin of its own.
descriptions.Health/RuinStateConfig/DamagedRenderCond: The damage levels at which the object is drawn damaged.
The health (0 to 1) at or below which the condition applies.
The look that is switched on at that health.
descriptions.Health/RuinStateConfig/GenericRuinsOverw: The region whose generic ruin is used instead of the object's own.
descriptions.Health/RuinSmokeParticles: The particle effects of smoke that rises from the ruin.
descriptions.Health/RuinSmokeParticles/SmokeParticleF: The particle effect file of one smoke.
descriptions.Health/RuinSmokeParticlesMin: The least number of smoke effects placed on a ruin.
descriptions.Health/RuinSmokeParticlesMax: The most smoke effects placed on a ruin.
descriptions.Health/RuinSmokeParticleRectBorderPercen: How far from the edge of the ruin's rectangle smoke may start, in percent.
descriptions.Health/ExplosionEffects: The particle effects played when the object is destroyed.
descriptions.Health/ExplosionEffects/ExplosionEffectF: The particle effect file of one explosion.
descriptions.Health/ExplosionEffectsMin: The least number of explosion effects played.
descriptions.Health/SelfHealPerHealTick: How much health the object regains at each healing step.
descriptions.Health/SelfHealPausedTimeIfAttacked: How long self-healing stays paused after an attack.
descriptions.Health/PassiveRuinRepairTime: How long a ruin takes to repair without help.
descriptions.Health/PassiveRuinRepairSpeed: How fast a ruin repairs itself.
descriptions.Health/DestructionWarScore: The war score the enemy gains when it destroys the object.
descriptions.Health/ShipwreckedUnitDamage: The damage a unit takes while it is shipwrecked.
descriptions.Health/ShipwreckedUnitDamage/Damage: The damage taken at each step.
descriptions.Health/ShipwreckedUnitDamage/InitialTime: The time before the first step.
descriptions.Health/EncampedUnitSelfHealMultiplier: A factor on healing while units are encamped.
descriptions.Health/AccuracySize100: The size that counts as the target for accuracy rules at full size.
descriptions.Health/OverrideAttackMarkerScale: A scale for the marker that shows the object is under attack.
descriptions.Health/UnderAttackEffectHealthThreshold: The health below which the under-attack effect starts.
descriptions.Health/UnderAttackEffectConfig: The effect asset that is shown while the object is under attack.
descriptions.Movement: How a vehicle or unit moves: its speed, how it turns and how wind, river currents, cargo and damage change that.
descriptions.Movement/UsesDrifting: Whether the vehicle drifts sideways when it turns.
descriptions.Movement/UsesAvoidance: Whether the vehicle steers away from others.
descriptions.Movement/Layer: The path-finding layer the vehicle moves on (land, water, air).
descriptions.Movement/Acceleration: How fast the vehicle speeds up.
descriptions.Movement/Deceleration: How fast the vehicle slows down.
descriptions.Movement/TurnCornerRadius: The radius of the curve the vehicle drives at a corner.
descriptions.Movement/TurnDecelerationFactor: How strongly the vehicle slows down in a turn.
descriptions.Movement/RotationSpeed: How fast the vehicle turns while it moves.
descriptions.Movement/SpotTurnRotationSpeed: How fast the vehicle turns on the spot.
descriptions.Movement/TurnAroundCircleRadius: The radius of the circle the vehicle needs to turn round.
descriptions.Movement/RotateWhileMovingFactor: A factor on turning while the vehicle is moving.
descriptions.Movement/CornerJumpingDistance90DegreeAn: The distance at which a 90 degree corner is cut.
descriptions.Movement/BuffBaseSpeed: An addition to the base speed that a buff gives.
descriptions.Movement/BuffTransferSpeed: An addition to the speed while goods are moved that a buff gives.
descriptions.Movement/Wind: How the wind changes the speed.
descriptions.Movement/Wind/AffectedByWind: Whether the wind changes the speed.
descriptions.Movement/Wind/SpeedFactorAtFavorableWind: The speed factor with the wind behind, on a straight course.
The speed factor with the wind behind, in a turn.
descriptions.Movement/Wind/SpeedFactorAtUnfavorableWi: The speed factor against the wind, on a straight course.
The speed factor against the wind, in a turn.
descriptions.Movement/RiverCurrent: How a river's current changes the speed.
descriptions.Movement/RiverCurrent/AffectedByRiverCur: Whether a river's current changes the speed.
descriptions.Movement/RiverCurrent/SpeedFactorAlongRi: The speed factor along the current, on a straight course.
The speed factor along the current, in a turn.
descriptions.Movement/RiverCurrent/SpeedFactorAgainst: The speed factor against the current, on a straight course.
The speed factor against the current, in a turn.
descriptions.Movement/FavorableWindAngle: The angle to the wind, in degrees, within which the wind counts as favourable.
descriptions.Movement/Cargo: How the cargo slows the vehicle.
descriptions.Movement/Cargo/AffectedByCargo: Whether the load changes the speed.
descriptions.Movement/Cargo/Threshold: The share of the load (0 to 1) from which the speed is reduced.
descriptions.Movement/Cargo/SpeedFactorAtThreshold: The speed factor at that load.
descriptions.Movement/Cargo/SpeedFactorAtFullLoad: The speed factor with a full load.
descriptions.Movement/Damage/Threshold: The share of damage (0 to 1) from which the speed is reduced.
descriptions.Movement/Damage/SpeedFactorAtThreshold: The speed factor at that damage.
descriptions.Movement/Damage/SpeedFactorAtFullDamage: The speed factor at the highest damage.
descriptions.Movement/BuffReduceCargoImpact: How much a buff lessens the slowing by cargo.
descriptions.Movement/BuffReduceDamageImpact: How much a buff lessens the slowing by damage.
descriptions.Movement/BuffReduceNegativeWindImpact: How much a buff lessens the slowing by an unfavourable wind.
descriptions.Movement/BuffReducePositiveWindImpact: How much a buff lessens the speed-up by a favourable wind.
descriptions.Movement/BuffReduceNegativeRiverCurrentI: How much a buff lessens the slowing by a current against the vehicle.
descriptions.Movement/BuffReducePositiveRiverCurrentI: How much a buff lessens the speed-up by a current along the vehicle.
descriptions.Movement/Collisions: How the vehicle behaves when it meets others or the shore.
descriptions.Movement/Collisions/UsesDrifting: Whether a collision lets the vehicle drift.
descriptions.Movement/Collisions/MaximumRotationalDri: The most the vehicle may turn from its course by drifting.
descriptions.Movement/Collisions/MaximumPositionalDri: The most the vehicle may be pushed sideways by drifting.
descriptions.Movement/Collisions/UsesAvoidance: Whether the vehicle steers away from what it might hit.
descriptions.Movement/Collisions/ColliderInnerLength: The length of the inner part of the vehicle's collision shape.
descriptions.Movement/Collisions/ColliderRadius: The radius of the vehicle's collision shape.
descriptions.Blocking: The ground an object blocks and how it treats the objects and the ground around it.
descriptions.Blocking/GroundPolygonAsset: The polygon asset that gives the ground the object covers.
descriptions.Blocking/OverbuildPlaza: Whether the object may be built over a plaza.
descriptions.Blocking/OverbuildGardenPolygon: Whether the object may be built over a garden's ground.
descriptions.Blocking/RemovePreviousGroundPolygon: Whether an earlier ground polygon under the object is removed.
descriptions.Blocking/UseQuayAreaForGroundPoly: Whether the quay's area gives the ground polygon.
descriptions.Blocking/RemoveFromWater: Whether the object removes water under it.
descriptions.Blocking/DisableBlockingByDefault: Whether the object blocks nothing until it is switched on.
descriptions.Blocking/BlockHarborFeedback: Whether the object blocks the harbor feedback layer.
descriptions.Blocking/SuppressDangerToAnimals: Whether animals near the object are left out of danger rules.
descriptions.Blocking/SuppressesRoundStreetCurves: Whether streets next to the object are not rounded into curves.
descriptions.Blocking/ProvideLocalHeightForFeedbackLa: Whether the object supplies a local height to the feedback layer.
descriptions.Blocking/ProvideLocalHeightForStreetLaye: Whether the object supplies a local height to the street layer.
descriptions.Blocking/NeedsGuaranteedSeaAccess: Whether the object needs a free way to the sea.
descriptions.Blocking/HarbourAreaSize: The size of the harbor area that is kept free.
descriptions.Blocking/CreateBorderRect: For which kinds of mesh graph a border rectangle is made.
descriptions.Blocking/EditorLineOfSightBlocking: Whether the object blocks the line of sight in the editor.
descriptions.Selection: How an object is selected: its interface, its colours and who may select it.
descriptions.Selection/GUIType: The interface that opens when the object is selected.
descriptions.Selection/RuinGUIType: The interface that opens for the object while it is a ruin.
descriptions.Selection/OMHeaderImage: The header picture of the object's window.
descriptions.Selection/Selectable: Whether the player may select the object.
descriptions.Selection/IsMultiSelectionType: How the object takes part in a selection of several objects.
descriptions.Selection/InfoCornerNotOwned: The info asset shown for the object when another player owns it.
descriptions.Selection/ParticipantMessageArcheType: The kind of participant that messages about the object are sent to.
descriptions.Selection/Colors: The colours of the outline that marks the object when it is selected or under the pointer.
descriptions.Selection/DetectionCfg: A file that gives the shape used to detect the object under the pointer.
descriptions.Selection/DetectionToken: An asset that stands for the object when it is detected.
descriptions.Selection/OnlySelectableForOwnerAndAllia: Whether only the owner and its allies may select the object.
descriptions.Selection/SelectableOnStart: Whether the object can be selected as soon as the game starts.
descriptions.Selection/ShowHighlightSubTileRect: Whether a highlight is drawn for the part of a tile the object covers.
descriptions.Selection/PreventBuildBlockerRenderOnSel: Whether the build blocker is not drawn while the object is selected.
descriptions.Locked: Whether the asset is available: its state at the start of the game, who it concerns and whether it shows while locked.
descriptions.Locked/DefaultLockedState: Whether the asset starts locked (1) or unlocked (0).
descriptions.Locked/Scope: The level at which the lock applies: the player, an island or another scope.
descriptions.Locked/VisibleWhenLocked: Whether the asset is shown in menus while it is still locked.
descriptions.Mesh: The model of an object: where it is placed, its default animation and how it is drawn.
descriptions.Mesh/ObjectPosition: How the model is placed on the ground (on land, on water, in the air).
descriptions.Mesh/MeshPlacement: How the model is fitted to the ground.
descriptions.Mesh/DefaultSequence: The animation the model plays when nothing else is asked.
descriptions.Mesh/DefaultSequence/SequenceAction: The kind of action of the animation.
descriptions.Mesh/DefaultSequence/SequenceInfo: The kind of information that goes with the animation.
descriptions.Mesh/DefaultSequence/SequenceVariant: The number of the variant of the animation.
descriptions.Mesh/ConstructionEffectCfg: The effect file played while the object is constructed.
descriptions.Mesh/ConstructionEffectScale: The scale of the construction effect.
descriptions.Mesh/GridHighlightEffect: Whether the grid is highlighted under the object.
descriptions.Mesh/HeatEffect: Whether the object gives off a heat shimmer.
descriptions.Mesh/IsVisibleInTemplateMapImage: Whether the object is drawn into the picture of a map template.
descriptions.Mesh/IsHuge: Whether the model counts as very large (it is then drawn and culled by other rules).
descriptions.Mesh/OverwriteIsMobileFlag: Whether the model is drawn as a moving object whatever its kind.
descriptions.Mesh/UseRandomVariationVisibleFlags: Whether the visible parts of the model are chosen at random.
descriptions.Mesh/UsableVariationVisibleFlags: The visible-part flags the random choice may use.
descriptions.Object: What kind of object an asset is, how it is owned and where the editor may place it.
descriptions.Object/Type: The kind of object (building, vehicle, prop, ...).
descriptions.Object/Skins: The skins an object has, the looks that can be switched.
descriptions.Object/Skins/SkinList/SkinAssetGuid: The skin asset of one entry of the list.
descriptions.Object/AssignDefaultProfile: Whether the object is given its default owner profile when it is created.
descriptions.Object/DefaultProfile: The owner profile the object gets by default.
descriptions.Object/AddToEditorObjectGrid: Whether the editor adds the object to its object grid.
descriptions.Object/PlacableInEditor: Whether the map editor may place the object.
descriptions.Object/SelectableInEditor: Whether the map editor may select the object.
descriptions.Object/LoadFromDemoSavegame: Whether the object is taken from the demo's saved game.
descriptions.Object/LoadFromDemoMap: Whether the object is taken from the demo's map.
descriptions.Text/OasisId: The id of a text in the game's text files that the asset shows.
descriptions.AssetPool: A list of assets that other assets draw from or are tested against, each with a weight.
descriptions.AssetPool/AssetList/Probability: The weight with which the asset is chosen.
descriptions.Infolayer: The picture and place of the symbol that an info layer shows above an object.
descriptions.Infolayer/DefaultInfoLayer: The info layer icon shown by default.
descriptions.Infolayer/AdditionalYOffset: How much higher the symbol is drawn.
descriptions.Item: A collectable or tradable item: how rare it is, what it is worth and where it comes from.
descriptions.Item/Allocation: Where the item may be used.
descriptions.Item/Niche: The niche (the kind of use) the item belongs to.
descriptions.Item/TradePrice: The price of the item when it is traded.
descriptions.Item/IsMetaItem: Whether the item belongs to the whole game (the account) rather than one session.
descriptions.Item/RemoveFromMetaStorage: Whether the item leaves the game-wide storage when it is used.
descriptions.Item/BarkPool: The pool of spoken lines the item's owner may say.
descriptions.Item/RaceTrackConfig: How the item takes part in chariot races.
descriptions.Item/RaceTrackConfig/ItemRacerPreset: The preset of the racer the item stands for.
descriptions.Item/RaceTrackConfig/RacerChariotVisuals: The look of the chariot's driver.
descriptions.Item/RaceTrackConfig/OverwriteRacerAsset: A model that is used for the racer instead of the preset's.
descriptions.Item/RaceTrackConfig/OverwriteRacerColor: A colour that is used for the racer instead of the preset's.
descriptions.Item/RaceTrackConfig/CanBeUsedForRaceCha: Whether the item may be used in a race challenge.
descriptions.Item/ItemGender: The grammatical gender of the item's name, for texts.
descriptions.Item/NeededPrestige: The prestige the player needs to use the item.
descriptions.Item/MythicEffect: The effect asset that the item gives in its mythic form.
descriptions.Item/IsHeroRacer: Whether the item is a hero among the racers.
descriptions.LogisticNode: How a building takes part in the goods transport: its carriers and its loading queue.
descriptions.LogisticNode/TransporterCountMax: The most carriers the building uses at once.
descriptions.LogisticNode/TransporterAsset: The carrier asset the building sends out.
descriptions.LogisticNode/QueueConfiguration: How goods are loaded and unloaded at the building.
descriptions.LogisticNode/QueueConfiguration/Processi: How many carriers are served at the same time.
descriptions.LogisticNode/QueueConfiguration/LoadingS: Whether missing workforce slows the loading.
descriptions.LogisticNode/QueueConfiguration/MinMissi: The slowest the loading may get through missing workforce, as a factor.
descriptions.LogisticNode/NeedsTransporterQueue: Whether carriers wait in a queue at the building.
descriptions.Factory7: The extra settings of a production building: its fertility, raw resource and whether it farms.
descriptions.Factory7/NeededFertility: The fertility the building needs on its island.
descriptions.Factory7/IsAgriculture: Whether the building is a farm.
descriptions.Factory7/RawResourceType: The kind of raw resource the building produces from.
descriptions.Factory7/MinFarmfieldProductivity: The least productivity a farm field must have for the building to work.
descriptions.FactoryBase: What a production building takes in and gives out, and how far its carriers go.
descriptions.FactoryBase/FactoryOutputs/StorageAmount: How much of the output the building stores.
descriptions.FactoryBase/FactoryOutputs/OverrideTrans: Whether this output uses a carrier range of its own.
descriptions.FactoryBase/NeedsFuelInput: Whether the building needs fuel to work.
descriptions.FactoryBase/FuelStorageAmount: How much fuel the building stores.
descriptions.FactoryBase/MissingConnectionInfolayer: The info layer icon shown when the building has no road connection.
descriptions.FactoryBase/ProductionOutputInfotip: The info tip that explains the building's output.
descriptions.FactoryBase/FetchesInputGoodsDirectlyFro: Whether inputs are taken straight from the area's storage, without carriers.
descriptions.FactoryBase/OverrideMaxTransporterRange: Whether the building uses the carrier range given here.
descriptions.FactoryBase/MaxTransporterRange: The greatest distance its carriers go.
descriptions.FactoryBase/TransporterRangeEffectivePer: The share of the range, in percent, that counts for goods transport.
descriptions.Product: A good, the workforce or another thing that is produced, consumed and traded.
descriptions.Product/ProductColor: The colour that stands for the product in statistics.
descriptions.Product/StorageLevel: The storage level that decides in which storages the product is kept.
descriptions.Product/IsWorkforce: Whether the product is a kind of workforce.
descriptions.Product/BasePrice: The base price of the product.
descriptions.Product/CivLevel: The civilisation level the product belongs to.
descriptions.Product/CanBeNegative: Whether the stock may fall below zero.
descriptions.Product/ProductionRegions: The regions in which the product is made.
descriptions.Product/ProductionRegions/RegionType: A region where the product is made.
descriptions.Product/ProductionRegions/RequiredDLCs: The downloadable content a region needs to make the product.
descriptions.Product/ProductionRegions/RequiredDLCs/R: A content product the region needs.
descriptions.Product/UiSound: The sound played when the product is shown or chosen in the interface.
descriptions.Product/TransportGoodsType: The kind of cargo the product is when it is carried.
descriptions.Product/ObtainHint: The text id of a hint that tells where to get the product.
descriptions.Need: A need of the residents and which product, category and attributes it stands for.
descriptions.Need/NeedProduct: The product that satisfies the need.
descriptions.Need/NeedCategoryType: The category of the need (a good, a service, ...).
descriptions.Need/SupplyWeight: How much the need weighs in the supply of a residence.
descriptions.Need/NeedAttributes: The attributes a satisfied need adds, one per kind of attribute.
descriptions.Need/NeedDescription: The text id of the need's description.
descriptions.Need/SecondPartyRelevant: Whether the need also counts for a second party.
descriptions.Culture: The sets of things a culture owns, and its mood picture.
descriptions.Culture/Sets: The sets that belong to the culture.
descriptions.Culture/CultureMoodImage: The picture that shows the culture's mood.
descriptions.Upgradable: The upgrades an object may take, what they cost and how they are applied.
descriptions.Upgradable/PossibleUpgrades: The upgrades the object may take.
descriptions.Upgradable/PossibleUpgrades/UpgradeGUID: An upgrade the object may take.
descriptions.Upgradable/PossibleUpgrades/Cost/Amount: How many of the ingredient the upgrade costs.
descriptions.Upgradable/PossibleUpgrades/Cost/Ingredi: A product or item the upgrade costs.
descriptions.ProductionChain: A group of production buildings that are built together, in up to three tiers.
descriptions.ProductionChain/ConstructionMenuAddition: An extra unlock that must be met for the chain to show in the construction menu.
descriptions.ProductionChain/Building: The first building of the chain.
descriptions.ProductionChain/Tier1: The buildings of the first tier, each with its own second tier.
descriptions.ProductionChain/Tier1/Building: A building of the first tier.
descriptions.ProductionChain/Tier1/Tier2: The buildings of the second tier that follow it.
descriptions.ProductionChain/Tier1/Tier2/Building: A building of the second tier.
descriptions.ProductionChain/Tier1/Tier2/Tier3: The buildings of the third tier that follow it.
descriptions.ProductionChain/Tier1/Tier2/Tier3/Buildi: A building of the third tier.
descriptions.ProductionChain/InfoTipHeight: The height of the chain's tooltip.
descriptions.Ornament: A decorative building that adds splendour, with its plaza size, description and mood picture.
descriptions.Ornament/PlazaSize: The size of the plaza the ornament stands on.
descriptions.Ornament/OrnamentIconInfotip: The info tip shown for the ornament's icon.
descriptions.Ornament/OrnamentDescription: The text id of the ornament's description.
descriptions.Ornament/MusicHall: The music state that a music hall sets.
descriptions.Ornament/MusicHall/MusicStateGroup: The group of music states the hall switches.
descriptions.Ornament/MusicHall/MusicStateActive: The state set while the hall is active.
descriptions.Ornament/MusicHall/MusicStateInactive: The state set while the hall is not active.
descriptions.Ornament/MoodImage: The picture that shows the ornament's mood.
descriptions.Warehouse: How much a warehouse stores and how it handles overflow.
descriptions.Warehouse/WarehouseStorage/StorageMax: The largest amount stored per product.
descriptions.Warehouse/WarehouseStorage/StorageMin: The least amount kept per product.
descriptions.Warehouse/IsStorageConsideredOverflowSto: Whether the storage counts as overflow storage.
descriptions.Warehouse/OverflowStorageList: The list of products the overflow storage takes.
descriptions.Warehouse/OverflowStorageRiskMultiplier: A factor on the risk of overflow.
descriptions.StorageBase/ProductStorageList: The list of products the storage holds.
descriptions.StorageBase/CanStoreAllNormalProducts: Whether the storage holds every ordinary product.
descriptions.Tech: A technology that can be researched: its names and pictures, what it costs and what it gives.
